subject: Org pulse: week-of-Jul-5 progress heatmap + priority asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Executive Leadership <leadership-distro@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett, vivek_kulkarni, markus_klein
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Org pulse: week-of-Jul-5 progress heatmap + priority asks

Team — attaching a compact progress heatmap ahead of Tuesday’s QBR dry run. I ran a quick pass across Product, Serving, and Sales to surface where exec attention should go this week. High level: progress on Dedicated capacity targets, a new regression signal in batcher latency, and one late procurement item that could block a partner launch.

Highlights (green):
- Dedicated pool utilization: +18% QoQ; two capacity pools meet SLOs after config tweaks. (Marcus + infra)
- Feature flags: streaming tool-calling reach is in canary with ~1k daily active flows. (Product)
- ARR motion: ACME onboarding completed PoC; they move to pilot next week. (Sales)

Red flags (amber/red):
- Batcher latency regression: 95th percentile up ~40ms for long-prefixed requests after framework patch. Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection fallback on T4s. Quick mitigation: roll back kernel selector v1.14 on canary nodes. (Action: Markus)
- Partner marketplace listing: procurement paperwork outstanding (vendor attestation + SOC extract). This is the gating item for the July 20 marketplace push. (Action: Laura + Legal)

Priority asks (concise):
1) Markus: schedule a 30-min hotfix window today to roll back kernel selector on canary, status update by 11:30 PT.
2) Laura: confirm vendor attestation submission and share timeline with procurement by EOD.
3) Vivek: help prioritize QBR slide that shows delta-to-plan for token/unit economics (one chart). Slide due Mon 5pm.

Attachments: QBR_heatmap_v2.pdf (2p) — heatmap + 3-line mitigation plan; ask_tracker_q3.csv — living tracker for owner status.

Notes: I kept the heatmap intentionally compact for the exec deck; we can expand any row if you want more telemetry slices. If no objections I’ll surface the patched kernel rollback as the operational highlight and ask for a follow-up postmortem slot in next week’s staff meeting.

—
Jordan Blake
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org pulse: week-of-Jul-5 progress heatmap + priority asks

Thanks — helpful and concise. Quick status: procurement has the SOC extract request; I pushed for a vendor-signed attestation this morning and they said they can provide by tomorrow COB. I’ll upload the signed doc to the Drive link and mark the ask_tracker.

On the kernel rollback: I’m OK with the rollback on canary if we get a short test plan (smoke + perf sanity) before promoting. Markus, can you paste the rollback steps and estimated user impact in the tracker?

Also: for the QBR slide, Vivek — happy to block 30 minutes Mon morning to iterate on the economics chart if that helps.

Laura

Subject: Re: Org pulse: week-of-Jul-5 progress heatmap + priority asks

Rolling this now on the canary cluster. Plan: revert kernel-selector commit, restart inference pools, run a 10-minute continuous query load (closed test harness), then validate 95/99 latency against baseline. Estimated impact: up to 1% request throttling during restart window; no customer-facing sessions expected to drop (we’ll keep streaming sessions sticky). I’ll log steps in the ask_tracker and paste a short runbook here once complete. Target status update by 11:30 PT.

I also added a short note in the heatmap about follow-up postmortem owners.

—Markus

Sarah, looping you here to confirm the KPIs you expect for the pilot.

Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme.com> — are you available for a 30-min pilot scope call Tue 9am PT? If not, propose alternatives.

I’ll also queue a 15-min postmortem slot in next Tues staff calendar for the batcher regression once Markus confirms mitigations.

Vivek
